description: This Java source file defines the ServiceContainer class, which manages service engine containers, including initialization, dispatcher management, and shutdown procedures within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: A container class for managing service dispatchers within the OFBiz framework, handling initialization, dispatcher retrieval, deregistration, and shutdown.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ServiceContainer with configuration, setting up the dispatcher factory based on configuration properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container; currently a no-op returning true.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the JobManager and deregisters all dispatchers.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.

methods.name: getLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a LocalDispatcher instance for a given dispatcher name and delegator, with caching.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes a dispatcher from cache and returns it.

methods.name: getAllDispatcherNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all dispatcher names currently cached.
